page.layout: One column of running text, with a rotated (vertical) marginal note along the left margin beside items VII to IX. Running head at top centre, page number at top left.

main_text.p: eft ius in orbitis illorum: femitas suas depra-uant iftis, cuiq; incedenti per aliquam earum, hic expers eft pacis. Isai.59,8.
Turpis lucri cupiditas] A minimo eorum vsq; ad maximum quisquis est, deditus est quæstui. Ierem.6,13.
Confusionum dissimulatio] Curant contritio-nem filiæ populi mei secundum curationem mali leuiculi, dicendo, pax,pax: etsi nulla est pax. Ierem.6,14.[illegible, ~20 letters]
Desperata contumacia] Omnes sunt cōtumacium contumacissimi, ambulantes cum detractione, chalybei & ferrei: omnes corruptores sunt. Ierem.6,28.

Doctrina] Visionem animi sui loquuntur, nō ex ore Iehovæ. Dicunt continēter iis qui spernunt Deum, loquūtus est Iehova, pax erit vobis: & cuique ambulanti ex sententia animi sui dicunt, non superueniet vobis malum. Ierem. 23,16,17.
Impii conatus] Putant se facturos, ut obliuiscatur populus nominis Dei per somnia sua, quæ enarrant quisque amico suo. Ierem.23,27.
Erroris efficacia] Seducunt populum falsitatibus suis, & rapiditate sua, cum Deus non mi-serit

page.notes: The rotated marginal text along the left edge is too small and skewed to read; it is marked as illegible. The page number 48 and the running head were read directly. The bottom line ("serit") completes a word broken at the line end ("mi-"), so it is printed as text. Long s is written as plain s throughout. No doubtful readings elsewhere.
